chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from 'Amr ibn 'Uthman, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Zayd al-Shahham, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about the Angel of Death. It is said that the earth is in front of him like a bowl, and he extends his hand from it wherever he wishes. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes'.

key_terms.الْقَصْعَةِ: A small bowl or dish, used here to describe the earth's appearance
key_terms.بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ: In front of him / before him

ai.seo_question: What is the description of the Angel of Death's view of the earth in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, elucidates the physical ease with which the Angel of Death executes his duty, emphasizing the divine facilitation of death. It reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of the angel's unique cosmological position, where the vastness of the earth is condensed for him, ensuring no soul is beyond his reach. This imagery underscores the omnipotence of Allah in managing the transition of souls without geographical constraint.
